title: Cohomology base change for module complexes
statement: Let $R\to B$ be a map of commutative rings and let $K$ be a cochain complex of $R$-modules, with cohomology as in [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $F=B\otimes_R-$ and $U$ be extension and restriction of scalars, and extend $F$ termwise to complexes as in [def-pc-ring-tensor-cohomology]. Define $c_K^i:B\otimes_R H^i(K)\to H^i(B\otimes_R K)$ to be the adjoint under $F\dashv U$ of the map on cohomology induced by the unit $K\to UFK$, using the exact-restriction identification $H^i(UFK)=UH^i(FK)$. Tensor symmetry identifies this with the right-sided tensor convention. For bounded-above complexes of free modules, $FK$ computes $K\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}B$.
